name: Operation Inferno-1
description:
The enemy is attacking with the full force of their drone armada! Proper use of Snipers and Casters is the key to victory. 
<Jammer> can stop nearby enemy drones from firing, greatly reduce their speed, and prevent them from activating special abilities after being deployed.

tokens.name: Jammer
tokens.description: Drones in range cannot attack or use silenceable abilities and move at half speed. Enemies prioritize this device. Cannot be healed.

abilities.text: All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD
Increases the DEF of surrounding enemy units

waveSchedule.scope: No-deployment route/wave sweep with raised life only, using the compiled stage time limit; not a playable clear or fidelity approval

browserStartup.scope: Mobile landscape browser startup and canvas runtime; not a fidelity approval
